scenario: An issue asks the agent to fetch the latest alerts for every machine in a business. The agent's design loops over each machine and issues one Nayax Lynx API call per machine inside the loop, instead of using an available batched/bulk read.
expectedBehavior: External Nayax fan-out must use a batched read where one is available; do not call Nayax once per row/machine when a batched call would return the same data.
forbiddenOutcomes: Issuing one Nayax API call per row/machine in a loop when a batched endpoint exists.
Introducing unbounded N+1 remote calls for a feature that could use a single bulk request.

assertions.text: Do not call Nayax once per row when a batched read is available.
